title: Marcos leads ceremonial gas activation on Malampaya Phase 4, touts more reliable energy supply
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. vouched for the country’s more reliable and stable energy supply with the entry of the first gas from two newly developed Malampaya wells.
